subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises and names some letters of the alphabet, such as letters in own name

show.line: Three letters! This is s. s, s, snake. This is a. a, a, apple. This is t. t, t, tap.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says s.
Tap the letter that says t.
This letter says a. Say the sound!
Sam starts with s. Tap the first letter of Sam.
Which letter does it start with? Sort the pictures.

hints: s is curly like a snake. t is tall with a cross. a is round.
Say the picture word. Listen for the first sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the letter that says t.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one! The curly one says t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The curly letter says s. t is the tall one with a cross.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Tall with a cross. That is t!

parent_line: Can recognise the letters s, a and t and say their sounds.
